subject: Packaging options and conversion rules for Clearline pilot
messages:
From: Sam Patel <sam@clearline.ai>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, May 2, 2027 at 09:12 AM PDT
Subject: Clarifying packaging options for Clearline pilot

Hi Chloe / Ben,

Thanks again for the walkthrough earlier. A couple of asks from our side as we finalize the pilot scope:

- We want the ability to upgrade from the pilot into a dedicated pool without losing pilot credits. Is there a standard "rollforward" for pilot credits if we convert mid-quarter?
- On features: can we purchase the KV-cache + experiment rollouts as an a la carte addon separate from seat/throughput? We need a path to syndicate certain features across teams.
- Pricing: what's the delta between a pooled throughput seat vs a reserved dedicated GPU for our expected 300 req/s sustained? Any quick numbers would help.

I'm attaching our internal constraints doc.

Best,
Sam
Procurement / Clearline AI

Attachment: Clearline_constraints.pdf (pdf)

From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
To: Sam Patel <sam@clearline.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, May 2, 2027 at 11:03 AM PDT
Subject: Re: Clarifying packaging options for Clearline pilot

Hi Sam —

Appreciate the clear list. Short answers up front, details below and attached spreadsheet with three paths.

- Rollforward: we can roll pilot credits into a dedicated commitment if conversion happens within the pilot window; typical policy is pro-rated credit transfer plus a small conversion uplift (~5%) to cover reservation delta. Ben, flag if we want to offer an alternative.
- Feature syndication (KV cache + experiment rollouts): we can surface those as named addons. Two options: attach to seats (per-seat entitlement) or buy a platform-level feature bundle (shared across org). The bundle is cheaper at scale.
- Throughput vs reserved: for ~300 req/s sustained, a reserved rack (2xA100 equiv) is materially cheaper per-token and gives predictable latency. I'll put numbers in the attachment.

Action items:
- Sam: confirm whether Clearline prefers org-level feature bundle or per-team seats by EOD Wed 5/4.
- Ben: can you provide the delta numbers and recommended rollout credit in the sheet? I'll send a final MA P draft after.

Thanks,
Chloe Martin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0162

Attachment: pack-options-clearline-v1.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, May 3, 2027 at 09:10 AM PDT
Subject: Re: Clarifying packaging options for Clearline pilot

Chloe —

Following up on your ask. I ran quick models in the sheet: two commercial levers we can push.

1) Pilot rollforward: standard is pro-rata credit transfer. For this account, propose a one-time conversion uplift of 5% and a pilot-credit carryover cap of $25k.
2) Discounting: if Clearline commits to a 12-month dedicated capacity after pilot we can offer a 10% ACV discount + waived onboarding credits (up to $15k) or instead a $20k one-time pilot credit if they go with an annual prepay.

On feature syndication:
- Org-level feature bundle (KV-cache + rollout + tracing): list price $6k/mo; at >=3 teams we can offer 30% bundle discount.
- Per-seat entitlement: $45/seat/mo (less economical above 20 seats).

If legal signs off on the conversion uplift I'll add the terms to the draft SLA. Kimberly — need quick OK on the 10% ACV discount and pilot carryover cap.

- Ben
Senior Sales, Redwood Inference

(See attached: pricing-models-CL-tab.xlsx)

Attachment: pricing-models-CL-tab.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, May 5, 2027 at 04:04 PM PDT
Subject: Re: Clarifying packaging options for Clearline pilot

Thanks team — I reviewed.

Approve the 10% ACV discount for a 12-month post-pilot dedicated commitment, with conditions:
- Conversion uplift at 5% is fine.
- Pilot credit carryover cap: $20k (reduce from $25k). We should protect revenue.
- Offer the $20k one-time pilot credit only if they prepay annually.
- Include a 30-day rollback window in the SOW allowing one-time downgrade without penalty within first 30 days after conversion.

Chloe: you can send the final MA P + SOW. Add the DocuSign link (see below) and include the attached SOW stub.
